title: Oatmeal Blueberry Cookies
excerpt: Make delicious oatmeal blueberry cookies, crisp on the outside and soft on the inside. An extra-easy, tasty homemade snack, perfect with afternoon coffee.
imageAlt: Golden oatmeal cookies with whole fresh blueberries on a metal tray lined with parchment paper.

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup ground panela (unrefined cane sugar) or brown sugar

steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and grease a baking sheet or line it with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, beat the butter with the ground panela until creamy and even.
Add the egg along with the vanilla and keep beating until the wet ingredients are fully combined.
Add the flour, rolled oats, baking powder, cinnamon and salt. Mix gently with a spatula until a soft dough forms.
Gently fold in the Fresh Pick blueberries, grown in the cold high-mountain lands of Guasca, taking care not to break the fruit so it stays juicy.
Form 12 balls of dough with a spoon and place them on the tray, leaving space between each one. Flatten them gently with the palm of your hand.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until the edges are golden. Let them rest on the tray for 5 minutes before moving them to a rack to cool.
tips: To keep the fruit from releasing too much juice while mixing, you can lightly toss the blueberries in a tablespoon of flour before adding them to the dough.
Store your completely cooled cookies in an airtight glass container to keep them crisp for up to 4 days.
You can freeze the dough already portioned into balls and bake them straight from the freezer whenever you want an instant fresh snack.
